outer_task: Frozen single-variable series, original context/horizon and exact complete official VAL/TEST window indices; no raw data preparation scripts
inner_folds: TRAIN first50% warmup, remaining50% split into four expanding chronological folds; each later block half CAL/half EVAL; purge H at bank/fit, fit/CAL, CAL/EVAL boundaries; CAL/EVAL stride H. Same folds for every backbone.
warmup_reason: RAFT non-overlap self mask needs >2*(L+H)-1+20 bank windows; original20% prefix invalid on Exchange. Freeze50% uniformly before new outcomes.
fold_backbone_fit: Fresh supervised fit on bank; epoch selection on fit; CAL selects fusion lambda; EVAL scores reward. No full-TRAIN checkpoint for inner predictions. Chronos uses frozen local pretrained snapshot.
final_backbone_fit: Fresh supervised training on full official TRAIN, selection on full official VAL; no TEST during fitting. Final three seeds. Chronos fresh inference shared across seeds, not three independent fits.
backbone_optimizer: Adam lr1e-4; PatchTST type3, iTransformer/RAFT type1; original architecture; all complete windows; checkpoint min selection MSE; no TEST selection
retriever_optimizer: AdamW lr.001 wd.0001 batch64 candidates256 clip5; fixed8 expert slots; same initialization/draws per seed; softmax mean-transfer memory MSE
aggregation: hard Top5 equal-weight mean-transfer for all final memories and all reward evaluations; preserve softmax-training/hard-inference limitation
lambda_selection: each backbone/arm/seed full VAL only; freeze all before TEST readout; identity baseline canonical lambda0
statistics: Compiler/activation stats use current fold bank+fit contexts only; backbone scaler uses fit TRAIN rows only; final stats use TRAIN only; population and sample std both saved; primary ddof1
initial_experts: Same original frozen Raw8 per dataset; no source/model selection using TEST; new optimization rerun in this run
pool_maintenance: KEEP stays in later rounds; max2 revisions; final iterative reward re-audit and deterministic deletion until positive or empty; record empty-pool alias to NoExpertMLP
reward_objectives: MemoryReward shared across backbones; FusionReward separately optimized for each backbone using own fold predictions; full/minus CAL-selected separately
ablation_no_critic: Same fusion leave-one reward, compiler, revision budget and final filter; skip separate Critic call, feed numeric evidence directly to revision
ablation_independent: Same fusion objective/LLM/maintenance, but score each singleton expert against NoExpertMLP instead of full-minus pool reward; fixed8 slots. Final checks use declared independent objective.
llm_budget: one initial knowledge path per dataset/objective/backbone; cache prompts/responses; no regenerate-by-test; 3 seeds refer to retriever training, not independent LLM draws
retired: No RAF, old unpurged reward, original-value memory aggregation, seed42 shared lambda, old-pool reference, old Gate/Switch/loss pilots in active core table. History retained.
interpretation: Previously observed TEST; exploratory unified rerun, not new blind test. Include negative results and empty pools. No cross-protocol best-value splicing.
authorization: User explicitly requested all models under unified latest protocol, selected per-backbone fusion rewards, and requested repository updates.
